2026-10-23: the Tauri/Svelte/PhaseUI client and its dedicated build, tests and CI were deleted. The current native TUI is implemented; see [TUI requirements](../../tui/requirements-and-backend-plan.md) for scope and the [terminal guide](../../tui/run-and-test.md) for operation and validation. For Core, see the [operations guide](../operations.md).

Historical design and acceptance are traced through fixed commits. Failed, untested or pending manual GUI acceptance does not become passed because the client is retired.
